summary: Explore 的 scope、repository SHA、historical blob 证据、semantic-id-only 与 authority separation 方向均可复现，且未发现 production/tests/Git 越权 mutation；但 OpenSpec Change scaffold 的形成违反 exact-runtime/real-execution boundary：Author 明确记录 packaged OpenSpec CLI 未能执行，却仍形成 .openspec.yaml、把 Run 标为 completed，并将 Proof F 标为 PASS。该过程问题是 blocking，不能由 metadata 字节碰巧正确来替代真实 OpenSpec 1.10.0 new-change execution。

findings.title: OpenSpec scaffold 在 exact runtime 未执行时被当作真实 mutation 接纳
findings.problem: Author result 明确写明当前环境无法执行 packaged OpenSpec CLI，但 payload 已包含 OpenSpec change scaffold，Run executionStatus=completed，Proof F=PASS。当前 AGENTS 要求：当前工作必须使用 exact runtime 而 runtime 缺失/不匹配时必须 STOP；OpenSpec 1.10.0 Explore skill 又明确禁止手工 scaffold，要求先运行 `openspec new change <name>`。因此该 Explore 把 source-level shape verification 当成了 real external-tool mutation evidence。
findings.invariant: required exact external mutation must come from real exact-runtime execution; missing required runtime is STOP, not completed/PASS; OpenSpec change scaffold must be created by `openspec new change`, not manually synthesized.
evidence: Author notes: packaged OpenSpec CLI could not execute because npm tgz does not bundle node_modules.
Author result executionStatus is completed and Proof F is PASS.
Exact OpenSpec 1.10.0 source confirms the scaffold shape is plausible, but this only verifies bytes/semantics, not the mandated execution provenance.
findings.requiredOutcome: Revise Explore using a real exact managed OpenSpec 1.10.0 runtime. Execute `openspec new change establish-lifecycle-authority-and-identity-contracts` from the clean authorized base/overlay boundary and record exact runtime identity plus command/result evidence. Rebuild the Explore evidence so Proof F is PASS only after that real mutation. If exact runtime still cannot execute, the Action must report blocked/STOP rather than completed and must not claim a valid OpenSpec scaffold mutation.
acceptance: Exact OpenSpec runtime identity resolves to 1.10.0 from the locked managed-tool boundary.
A real `openspec new change establish-lifecycle-authority-and-identity-contracts` execution is evidenced.
The resulting `.openspec.yaml` is bound to that execution, not only to source inspection/manual bytes.
Revised Run no longer claims completed/PASS when required runtime execution is unavailable.
No proposal/design/specs/tasks or production/test mutations are introduced during revise-explore.
